query:
with total_vio_per_person as (
SELECT 
  TIV.violator_id, 
  count(*) as total_violation_per_person
FROM 
  estishraf_llm_traffic_violation TIV
JOIN 
  estishraf_llm_demographics_impala DIM 
  ON DIM.id = CAST(TIV.violator_id AS DOUBLE)

WHERE 
  YEAR(TIV.gdate_happened) = 2024
  AND DIM.person_type = 'Saudi'
  AND TIV.status_description IN ('Issued to violator but un-paid', 'Issued to violator and paid')
group by 1
    )
    select 
    avg(total_violation_per_person) avg_violation_per_person_citizens 
    from total_vio_per_person LIMIT 1200
